tagline: Empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more
hero_kpi_rationale: The Microsoft Cloud segment (including Azure, Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, Dynamics 365) is the primary driver of growth and innovation, fully capturing the AI wave with Copilot, integrated AI services, and large-scale cloud infrastructure. With $168.9B in revenue (+23%), it represents the company's strategic core.

kpis.name: Microsoft Cloud Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from Microsoft's cloud services, including Azure, Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, and Dynamics 365.
kpis.description: Microsoft Cloud revenue grew strongly to $168.9 billion, driven by demand for intelligent enterprise solutions and Azure expansion.
kpis.signal: Strong growth fueled by AI adoption in the cloud

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high due to strong contributions from cloud services and licensing, with improvement linked to datacenter efficiency.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves due to cloud scale effects and cost discipline, despite AI investments.
kpis.signal: Very high operating margin, indicating industrial strength

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Microsoft is increasing R&D spending to strengthen its generative AI offerings and cloud capabilities, particularly with Copilot and Azure AI.
kpis.signal: Increased investment in AI and cloud platforms

kpis.name: Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from Microsoft 365 subscriptions for enterprises.
kpis.description: Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud revenue is a major source of recurring income, ensuring predictability and visibility, driven by Copilot adoption.
kpis.signal: Strong and growing base of recurring revenue

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.description: Microsoft maintains moderate headcount growth, focused on cloud, AI, and security divisions.
kpis.signal: Slight increase despite industry-wide optimization trends

kpis.name: Percentage of cloud deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence features.
kpis.description: More than half of new cloud deals now include AI features, such as Copilot and intelligent agents.
kpis.signal: Rapid AI adoption in enterprise solutions

kpis.name: Volume of AI API calls
kpis.explanation: Number of monthly calls to Azure's artificial intelligence APIs.
kpis.description: Volume of AI API calls has tripled in one year, reflecting massive integration of AI into customer applications.
kpis.signal: Explosive usage of AI services by developers

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company faces heightened competition in the technology sector, notably from companies such as Google, Amazon, and Facebook.

risks.title: Security
risks.score_rationale: Microsoft's products and services are vulnerable to cyberattacks, which could result in data losses and reputational damage.

risks.title: Software Sales Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Microsoft is heavily reliant on software sales, which could make the company vulnerable to market fluctuations.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Government regulations may impact Microsoft's operations, particularly in data protection and antitrust.

risks.title: Innovation
risks.score_rationale: Microsoft must continue innovating to remain competitive in the technology sector, which may prove challenging.

ai_positioning.summary: Microsoft is a leader in artificial intelligence, with significant investments in R&D for AI-related products and services. The company leverages AI to enhance its offerings, including cloud computing solutions and productivity tools.
